note: one-message-once (item 132): in Muster a builder's or designer's READY to the manager's chat is refused (it goes to the inspector, who copies the manager with its verdict), and a PASS or FAIL from anyone but an inspector or the manager is refused, relays included. A READY card no longer needs a message to the manager. Two new house rules, on in Muster by default and off for other projects (PINR unchanged); both copies; listed on docs/checks.md.
